children: According to Sina Finance, multiple people familiar with the matter said former U.S. Vice President Kamala Harris is laying the groundwork for a possible third presidential campaign, while her husband has privately told some people that he does not want her to run again. Some donors have also told Harris directly that her chances of success this time are slim.

Harris has said she has not yet decided whether to make another bid for the White House, but she has already taken several steps that could serve as campaign preparation, including meeting major donors, recruiting staff, and traveling to swing states to help Democratic candidates ahead of the November midterm elections. In public, she has said her focus remains on the midterms.

title: Harris's Husband Privately Says He Does Not Want Her to Run Again
